title: Execution mode and automatic choice
acceptance: Pilot chosen per request by domain and evidence; suggest-only defaults; owner promotion kept
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Implemented execution-mode pilot selection (domain + evidence, suggest-only default) and owner-only pilots.promote in 0.5 h agent.
